newsitem.title: USA: Stericycle purchases to add $2.3 mln in revenue/yr.
newsitem.headline: Stericycle purchases to add $2.3 mln in revenue/yr.

text.p: Stericycle Inc said Wednesday it completed three additional acquisitions, which are expected to increase annualized revenues by more than $2.3 million.

Stericycle, the largest provider of regulated medical waste management services in the United States, said it bought Regional Carting Inc, Rumpke Container Service Inc and the Wisconsin medical waste business of Waste Management Inc.

Stericycle said these acquisitions are part of its strategy to participate aggressively in the consolidation of the medical waste services industry and to penetrate more rapidly the alternate care market.

"We expect these three acquisitions will increase our annualized revenues by more that $2.3 million," Mark Miller, president, said in a statement. "When you combine them with our prior Waste Management (December 1996) and ECCO (1997) acquisitions, the total would increase our annualized revenue by more than $20 million."
He said Regional Carting in New Jersey, Rumpke in Ohio and the Waste Management business in Wisconsin strengthens the company's existing business in these regions.
